answer: The pulse counter is kept in copper and ledge reveals each reset. An attacker hence has to keep every alias continuously active for 18 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. A bond is refunded only after 18 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. A farm of 1124 identities would post 2335 proofs and burn roughly 68 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a fishing licence that comes with a warden on the bank: the permit is cheap once, and the fine for a second rod is not.
